themes_detail.label: Sudden Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests exploded to 3 complaints THIS WEEK, a 2300% spike versus the 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69), suggesting either widespread basket removal, damage, or a newly emerging waste management problem concentrated in specific blocks.
evidence: 3 litter basket complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% increase)
Z-score of 8.69 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Spike emerged suddenly with no prior escalation signal
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY about whether specific blocks lost baskets due to maintenance or budget cuts
Verify if spike is localized to one neighborhood pocket or district-wide

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Surging in Williamsbridge
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 10 reports last week, a 248% spike above the 2.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.04), marking the highest-volume safety complaint spike and signaling potential organized activity or hot-spot emergence.
evidence: 10 drug activity complaints last week vs. 2.9 weekly average (248% increase)
Z-score of 4.04 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Sustained elevated level suggests emerging trend rather than one-time incident
reporting_angles: Interview NYPD about specific blocks or intersections with highest concentration of complaints
Talk to community boards and residents about visible dealing, open-air markets, or new trafficking routes
Cross-reference with any recent arrests or enforcement actions

themes_detail.label: Trash Collection Collapse Two Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints spiked to 34 reports 2 weeks ago, a 504% increase over the 5.6 weekly average (z-score: 5.62), indicating a significant service failure that may still be affecting neighborhoods; current status unclear.
evidence: 34 missed collection complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.6 weekly baseline (504% increase)
Z-score of 5.62 indicates extreme statistical significance
Converges with longstanding CB budget request for equipment funding for Parks & Recreation
reporting_angles: Check if sanitation service was restored or if complaints have continued at elevated levels
Interview DSNY about whether truck breakdowns, staffing shortages, or route changes caused the failure
Ask community board if this reflects chronic underfunding of collection infrastructure

themes_detail.label: Obstruction Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Obstruction complaints jumped to 16 reports last week, a 212% spike versus the 5.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.94), suggesting sidewalk, street, or pedestrian access blockages becoming more frequent.
evidence: 16 obstruction complaints last week vs. 5.1 weekly average (212% increase)
Z-score of 3.94 indicates strong statistical anomaly
Converges with longstanding CB budget request for roadway maintenance
reporting_angles: Identify which blocks or street segments have the most obstruction complaints
Determine if obstructions are vendor-related, construction-related, or parking-related
Check if this spike relates to the concurrent vendor enforcement spike (3 complaints THIS WEEK)

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Reports 2 Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints spiked to 3 reports 2 weeks ago, a 1100% increase over the 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35), indicating potential environmental contamination or illegal dumping event; current status and follow-up unclear.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1100% increase)
Z-score of 6.35 indicates extreme statistical significance
Aligns with recurring CB requests for storm sewer inspection and environmental protection
reporting_angles: Contact DEP and DSNY to identify what hazardous materials were reported and where
Determine if complaints were filed at specific sites (e.g., industrial areas, dumpsites) or dispersed
Check for any ongoing environmental remediation or investigation
